blind.description: A stylized one-handed flanged mace. It features a pointed copper/bronze head with radiating triangular flanges and a spiked central cap, a short segmented metallic shaft wrapped in reddish-brown leather, and a pommel with an attached looped leather wrist strap. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully textured with metallic and leather materials. There are no detached shards or unpainted areas, though the weapon hovers at a tilted diagonal angle in mid-air above the floor rather than resting flat.
blind.from_above: Resembles a multi-pointed metallic star from the flanged head connected to a straight handle pointing upward with a rounded leather loop at the end, accompanied by a sharp silhouette shadow to the upper-left.
